page.overview:
What is Dragon Sword?

The Dragon Sword is a weapon with a wavy blade was designed to mimic the body of a Dragon. It was used by Liu Kang in Mortal Kombat 4 and Mortal Kombat Gold.

It makes a cameo appearance in Mortal Kombat 11 in the Wu Shi Dragon Grotto stage. Stationed in the center of the arena, the sword can be used as a means to traverse the arena, where fighters can jump off the sword's pedestal to travel a full-screens distance from the sword's location to either retreat from an opponent or advance towards them.

Alternatively, fighters can pull the sword from the stage to initiate an interactable Krushing Blow, slashing the opponent in the face with the sword to deal damage. Once the sword is pulled, the sword can not be used again, however the stone block/pedestal originally holding the sword can still be used to transverse the arena.
